messages:
Noah Patel: Hi all, Noah here 5, first day. I completed Okta passkey on my phone and accepted 1Password. Two blockers: I can't SSH to git@bastion.redwood (Permission denied) and I don't see the /Engineering shared drive. Who do I poke?
sarah-it: welcome Noah! For Drive that's group membership. For SSH, Okta passkeys are separate from SSH keys. Do you have ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub uploaded under Okta Profile -> Security -> SSH keys?
Noah Patel: I did upload a pubkey, but `ssh git@bastion.redwood` returns Permission denied. Verbose shows `key_load_private_type: invalid format`.
alex-sre: that error points to a bad/corrupt private key. Try `ssh-keygen -y -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` to verify. If it errors, regenerate with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "noah@redwood.com"` and re-upload the .pub to Okta.
Noah Patel: running ssh-keygen -y failed. I'll regenerate and re-upload.
it-bot: 1Password seat assigned to Noah Patel (noah@redwood.com) 5 invite accepted.
sarah-it: I just added you to eng-general; Drive access should appear in ~60-120s.
Noah Patel: regenerated key, re-uploaded, now `ssh` works and I can clone repos. Drive folder showed up too after logging out of Drive and back in. Thanks folks!
amanda-devex: welcome aboard! I'll DM the laptop bootstrap script (dotfiles + ssh-agent). If you hit any more provisioning snags ping #it.
